pending.subject: ⚠️ Alert: Pending Tool Returns
pending.title: ⚠️ Pending Returns Report
pending.body1: An updated report on tools that have not yet been returned has been generated.
pending.body2: Please check the attached Excel file to review all details (Folios, Workers, Machines, and Schedules).
pending.footer: This is an automated message generated by the Warehouse System.

weekly.subject: 📊 Weekly Summary: Tool History
weekly.title: 📊 Weekly Checkout Report
weekly.body1: Attached you will find the history of all tool checkouts and returns recorded over the last 7 days.
weekly.body2: Please check the attached Excel file to review the full summary of borrowed tools, folios, and usage times.
weekly.footer: This is an automated message generated by the Warehouse System.

stock.subject: ⚠️ Inventory Alert: Low Stock Tools
stock.title: ⚠️ Alert: Low Stock Tools
stock.body1: It has been detected that one or more tools have reached or fallen below their minimum stock level.
stock.body2: Please check the attached Excel file to view the complete list and manage necessary restocking.
stock.footer: This is an automated message generated by the Warehouse System.
